title: Alpha Compute phone
body: An agentic operating system, powered by elizaOS.
say: This is the Alpha Compute phone, powered by Eliza O S. Everything works by touch, chat, or voice.

title: Private by default
body: Counts, not content, until you unlock.
say: The lock screen shows counts, not content. Touch the sensor, or swipe up, to unlock.

title: Home
body: What matters now, every app, and one place to ask.
say: Home shows what matters now: your next meeting, what needs you, and every app in one grid. The bar at the bottom is Alpha.

title: Reply in place
body: Alpha drafts it. You approve it.
say: When Maya texts, Alpha drafts a reply in your voice. One tap to send.

title: Ask anything
body: Answers arrive as cards that open the right app.
say: Ask Alpha what needs you. Each answer is a card that opens the right place.

title: Mail and files
body: Attachments open in Files. Back returns you.
say: Jordan's term sheet opens straight from the email. Swipe back, and you're right where you were.

title: Voice
body: Hold the side key. Anywhere, even locked.
say: Hold the side key to talk, from anywhere.

title: Calendar
body: Your day at a glance. Alpha preps you for what's next.
say: Open an event, and Alpha preps you for it.

title: Notifications
body: Pull down for notifications and quick settings.
say: Pull down from the top for notifications and quick settings.

title: Calls
body: Calls keep going in the background.
say: Calls keep going while you use other apps. The chip in the status bar brings you back.

title: Camera and Photos
body: Capture, scan, and find any photo by asking.
say: Capture a photo, scan a document, or ask Alpha to find any picture.

title: Maps
body: Directions and navigation that keep running.
say: Get directions and start navigation. Guidance keeps running when you leave.

title: Wallet
body: Double-press the side key to pay.
say: Double-press the side key to pay, even from the lock screen.

title: Agentic browser
body: Alpha fills the page. You confirm before anything is final.
say: In the browser, ask Alpha to book a table. It fills the form, then waits for your approval.

title: Notes and transcription
body: Recorded, transcribed and summarized on device.
say: Record a meeting. Alpha transcribes it on the device and pulls out the action items.

title: Workflows
body: Describe a routine. Every run is logged step by step.
say: Describe a routine, and Alpha builds the workflow. Every run is logged, step by step.

title: Settings
body: Alpha's character, your accounts, and exactly what it can see.
say: Settings starts with Alpha's character and your accounts, with control over exactly what it can read or do.

title: One agent. Every app.
body:
Swipe up for Home · swipe in for Back · pull down for notifications.
alpha-phone-prototype.pages.dev
say: One agent. Every app. Always in your control.
